title: The Fishers Who Take Too Much

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After a poor catch, a fisher wonders whether distant fishers might have nets so large they could empty the sea.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a poor catch, (name1), a fisher, wonders whether distant fishers might have nets so large they could empty the sea.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fisher imagines great nets dragged by enormous boats and feels uneasy.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar wonders whether such fishing could leave nothing for the next generation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests distant fishers might follow rules about how much to take, as some Isolans do.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says rules are only as good as the people who follow them.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The fishers agree to rest one fishing spot for a season.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The fishers disagree and agree to watch the fish more closely before deciding.
